members.name: annotations
members.summary: Optional additional tool information. Display-name precedence: `title`, `annotations.title`, then `name`.

members.summary: A human-readable description of the tool.

members.summary: Execution-related properties (2025-11-25 only; removed in 2026-07-28).

members.summary: Optional set of sized icons for display (2025-11-25+).

members.summary: A JSON Schema object defining the expected parameters for the tool.

members.summary: See the MCP specification for notes on `_meta` usage.

members.name: output_schema
members.summary: An optional JSON Schema object defining the structure of the tool's output returned in the `structured_content` field of a `CallToolResult`.

items.name: Tool
items.summary: Definition for a tool the client can call.

members.name: destructive_hint
members.summary: If true, the tool may perform destructive updates to its environment. If false, the tool performs only additive updates. (This property is meaningful only when `read_only_hint == false`) Default: true

members.name: idempotent_hint
members.summary: If true, calling the tool repeatedly with the same arguments will have no additional effect on its environment. (This property is meaningful only when `read_only_hint == false`) Default: false

members.name: open_world_hint
members.summary: If true, this tool may interact with an "open world" of external entities. If false, the tool's domain of interaction is closed. For example, the world of a web search tool is open, whereas that of a memory tool is not. Default: true

members.name: read_only_hint
members.summary: If true, the tool does not modify its environment. Default: false

members.name: title
members.summary: A human-readable title for the tool.

items.name: ToolAnnotations
items.summary: Additional properties describing a Tool to clients.

members.name: mode
members.summary: Controls the tool use ability of the model: - "auto": Model decides whether to use tools (default) - "required": Model MUST use at least one tool before completing - "none": Model MUST NOT use any tools

items.name: ToolChoice
items.summary: Controls tool selection behavior for sampling requests (2025-11-25+).

members.name: task_support
members.summary: Whether this tool supports task-augmented execution. Absent means "forbidden".

items.name: ToolExecution
items.summary: Execution-related properties for a tool (2025-11-25 only).

items.name: ToolListChangedNotification
items.summary: An optional notification from the server to the client, informing it that the list of tools it offers has changed.

members.name: content
members.summary: The unstructured result content (same format as `CallToolResult.content`).

members.name: is_error
members.summary: Whether the tool use resulted in an error. Absent is equivalent to false.

members.name: meta
members.summary: Optional metadata. Clients SHOULD preserve this in subsequent sampling requests to enable caching optimizations.

members.name: structured_content
members.summary: An optional structured result value. Any JSON value on 2026-07-28; restricted to a JSON object on 2025-11-25.

members.name: tool_use_id
members.summary: The `id` of the `ToolUseContent` this result corresponds to.

members.name: type
members.summary: Discriminator for tool result content.

items.name: ToolResultContent
items.summary: The result of a tool use, provided by the user back to the assistant (2025-11-25+).

members.name: id
members.summary: Unique identifier for this tool call, used to correlate with ToolResultContent.

members.name: input
members.summary: Arguments to pass to the tool. Must conform to the tool's inputSchema.

members.name: meta
members.summary: Optional metadata. Clients SHOULD preserve this in subsequent sampling requests to enable caching optimizations.

members.name: name
members.summary: The name of the tool to invoke. Must match a tool name from the request's tools array.

members.name: type
members.summary: Discriminator for tool use content.

items.name: ToolUseContent
items.summary: An assistant's request to invoke a tool during sampling (2025-11-25+).

members.name: list_changed
members.summary: Whether this server supports notifications for changes to the tool list.

items.summary: Capability for tools operations.

members.name: uri
members.summary: The URI of the resource to unsubscribe from.

items.name: UnsubscribeRequestParams
items.summary: Parameters for a resources/unsubscribe request.

members.name: supported
members.summary: Protocol versions the server supports; the client should pick one and retry.

items.summary: Error data for the -32022 unsupported-protocol-version error (2026-07-28).

items.summary: Capability for URL mode elicitation (2025-11-25+).
